messages:
rachel-peopleops: Quick heads-up: short attestation window opens Tue Aug 2 and closes Aug 9 23:59 UTC. All staff and contractors must either attest or upload evidence by then. Form + upload link in bio: https://redwood.example.com/attest-aug2026 :calendar:

rachel-peopleops: New this round: please tag any third-party model vendors with a vendor-contact field when uploading. That helps scoping.

matt-eng: For eng squads 1: can we submit a single bundle per squad?

rachel-peopleops: Yes, please. Team leads may submit one bundle and list per-person artifacts in the form.

anya-security: Minimal guidance: infra = CMDB screenshot or asset export; services = dataflow + encryption confirmation; vendor integrations = contract excerpt + data handling note. If unsure, upload and mark "for review".

tom-privacy: Reminder: finish the 12-min privacy micro-course before attesting. The attestation form will surface the training link if your record is missing it. Please complete training by Aug 6 to leave time to upload proof.

remind-bot: Scheduled: "Attestation window opens" will also post in #general on Aug 3 09:00 UTC and an email reminder on Aug 7.

rachel-peopleops: Office hours: Aug 5 15:00-16:00 UTC with people-ops + security for walkthroughs and private 1:1 slots via the form. Contractor extension requests must be filed by Aug 4.

anya-security: We'll triage uploads as accepted / needs-info / escalate and aim to close reviews by Aug 16. For audit-priority items tag @anya-security in the form and include "audit:urgent" in the filename.

rachel-peopleops: TL;DR: attest + evidence due Aug 9 23:59 UTC; privacy training by Aug 6; team-lead bundles preferred; vendor contact required when applicable; office hours Aug 5. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
